meta.project: EDO Game: A Jornada do Cálculo 2

product_overview: EDO Game is a gamified learning platform for Calculus 2, focused on ordinary differential equations and series. It presents modules as a roadmap of short theory lessons followed by interactive practice activities.
core_goals: Browse and select a Calculus 2 module to study
Read concise theory content for a selected module
Complete interactive quiz activities by matching or placing answers
Solve drag-and-drop challenges related to module content

features.name: Module Selection Dashboard
features.description: The user can open the main dashboard and choose a learning module from the available Calculus 2 roadmap.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the available module roadmap -> Select a module to begin studying

features.name: Theory Content Viewer
features.description: The user can read short theory lessons for a selected module.
user_flows: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/theory -> View the theory lesson for the selected module -> Read the lesson content and formulas -> Continue to the next study activity

features.name: Interactive Quiz
features.description: The user can answer module questions by dragging options into the correct drop areas and progressing through the quiz.
user_flows: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/quiz -> Drag an option to the correct dropzone -> Move to the next question -> Complete the quiz and see the result
Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/quiz -> Drag an option to an incorrect dropzone -> Observe the answer as not accepted -> Try again with a different option -> Continue the quiz

features.name: Flashcard Review
features.description: The user can review module concepts through flashcard-style study cards.
user_flows: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/flashcards -> View the flashcard deck for the selected module -> Flip through cards to review concepts and formulas -> Continue reviewing until the deck is finished

features.name: Drag and Drop Challenge
features.description: The user can complete a challenge activity by arranging or matching items using drag and drop.
user_flows: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/challenge -> Drag items into the correct positions -> Review the completed arrangement -> Submit the challenge outcome

features.name: Global Leaderboard
features.description: The user can view the ranking page to compare progress or performance across players.
user_flows: Navigate to /ranking -> View the global leaderboard -> Compare rankings and scores

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Login with Google or play as Guest

features.name: Quiz Completion
features.description: Drag and drop to complete formulas or answer questions
